objective: Execute pinned local project Git updates and registered regressions through MCP with durable asynchronous receipts and readable reports
acceptance_criteria: Remote callers choose registered project/action and exact commit, never arbitrary commands/paths
Git origin/main/clean worktree/ancestry and exact expected commit verified before checkout
One durable asynchronous job per operation ID; project lock prevents overlapping updates, uncertain jobs are not replayed
Targeted and full Mac Python tests require positive test counts, with persisted actual SHA and exit codes
Bounded redacted log pages and job references survive Chat/MCP replacement
Local Alice end-to-end execution and distinct real web rollout boundary recorded; no Mint/BDS or other project mutation
